verdict.left_looks: A red barn with a stepped dark-oak gable and a dark brown shingle roof. A large white/quartz-framed barn door in the gable end with a plank double door and a hay bale or two inside. Tan wood corner posts with carved detail, a stone-brick base, and a fence line along the front. The long sides have red walls with pale vertical window slits. The back gable is a flat red wall with a tall window and a small door. It sits on a plank platform with no ground. Some of the walls look slightly skewed or tapered. Fairly plain and a bit bare.
verdict.right_looks: A red barn with a gambrel or curved stepped profile and a dark slate roof. A cupola or vent sits on the ridge. The front has a red and white checkerboard pattern with a big dark wood beam and a cross-shaped door frame. A hay loft opening has a hay bale, and hanging lanterns hang on chains. The walls have white crenellated trim along the gable edge. A stone base, fences, hay bales, barrels, and a grass and dirt ground plate with a path round out the scene. The side has window slits. The back is a large plain red wall with a cupola on top.
verdict.why: The right barn reads more clearly as a barn with character: a gambrel profile, a cupola, a checkerboard facade, a loft with hay, lanterns, and grounded props. The left is plainer and its walls look slightly skewed, and it floats on a bare platform.
